title: Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA)
description: A documented assessment of the risks a proposed automated processing activity poses to individuals' rights and freedoms, the system's high-risk classification, and the safeguards (including human review) put in place before processing begins.
evidence_description: A report documenting the necessity and proportionality of an automated processing activity, its risks to individuals' rights and freedoms, its classification against relevant high-risk categories, and the safeguards (including a specific pre-decision human-review mechanism) implemented to mitigate identified risks.
collection_method: Conducted by the data controller (or a data protection officer) before processing begins, and repeated whenever the system or its data changes materially.
retention_period: For the lifetime of the processing activity, plus a minimum of 3 years after it ends.
artifact_format: PDF or structured report, typically following a data protection authority's published DPIA template.

citations.title: NJCM c.s./De Staat der Nederlanden (SyRI judgment), ECLI:NL:RBDHA:2020:1878
citations.publisher: District Court of The Hague (Rechtbank Den Haag)
